from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date,time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
parents=json.loads((out/'parent_input_hashes.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for r in parents:
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'], '复用输入发生变化'
source_receipts=json.loads((out/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert len(source_receipts)==3 and all(r['status']=='DOWNLOADED_ORIGINAL_HTML' for r in source_receipts)
for r in source_receipts: assert hashlib.sha256((root/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']

panel=json.loads((base/'原公告字段及原因记录.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
metadata=json.loads((base/'actual_release_metadata.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def get_pdf(q):
 r=next(x for x in pdfs if x['quarter']==q)
 assert hashlib.sha256((base/f'sources/{q}_资金来源与用途原表.pdf').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 return [line for p in r['pages'] for line in p['text'].splitlines()]
def english_date(d):
 return datetime.strptime(d,'%Y-%m-%d').strftime('%B ')+str(int(d[8:10]))+', '+d[:4]
def after_date_values(line,d):
 marker=english_date(d)
 if marker not in line: return None
 suffix=line.split(marker,1)[1].strip()
 tokens=re.findall(r'\(?-?\d[\d,]*\)?',suffix)
 if len(tokens)!=7: return None
 return [(-1 if x.startswith('(') else 1)*int(x.strip('()').replace(',','')) for x in tokens]
def original_paras(q):
 soup=BeautifulSoup((base/f'sources/{q}_借款预估原公布.html').read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 records=[]
 for i,el in enumerate(soup.find_all(['p','li'])):
  t=el.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  if 0<len(t)<6000 and any(x in t for x in ['SOMA','Federal Reserve','FOMC','redemptions','redemption']):
   if t not in [x['text'] for x in records]: records.append({'dom_paragraph_index':i,'text':t,'text_sha256':hashlib.sha256(t.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()})
 return records

 ('fed20240501_statement',root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_revision_prior_policy_clock_v1/sources/20240501_FOMC原声明.html','2024-05-01','https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20240501a.htm'),
 ('fed20250319_statement',out/'sources/20250319_FOMC原声明.html','2025-03-19','https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20250319a.htm'),
 ('fed20251029_statement',root/'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/sources/20251029_声明.html','2025-10-29','https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20251029a.htm')
]

 for s in article.stripped_strings:
  if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}',s):

   except ValueError: continue

 ny=datetime.combine(dates[0],time(int(clock.group(1))+12,int(clock.group(2))),ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))
 assert ny.tzname()==clock.group(3)

 fed_text[sid]=text

rows=[]; raw_rows=[]; statements=[]
for case in protocol['fixed_cases']:
 q=case['quarter']; lines=get_pdf(q); oldd=case['prior_actual_release_date']; curd=case['actual_release_date']
 matches=[]
 for i,line in enumerate(lines):
  values=after_date_values(line,curd)

 policy=mapping.get(q)
 row={'quarter':q,'prior_treasury_body_date':oldd,'current_treasury_body_date':curd,'current_known_at_conservative_shanghai':current_proxy.astimezone(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'soma_signed_estimate_before':old[-1],'soma_signed_estimate_after':new[-1],'soma_redemption_estimate_before':-old[-1],'soma_redemption_estimate_after':-new[-1],'soma_memo_revision_reported':rev[-1],'displayed_soma_delta':new[-1]-old[-1],'borrow_revision_reported':rev[1],'borrow_displayed_pair_delta':new[1]-old[1],'other_sources_revision_reported':rev[2],'policy_source_id':None,'policy_announcement_date':None,'policy_formal_shanghai':None,'policy_effective_date':None,'prior_policy_calendar_days':None,'policy_after_prior_before_current':False,'simple_cap_path_change_in_signed_memo':None,'reported_memo_minus_simple_path':None,'cap_arithmetic_matches':None,'full_quantity_cause_identified':False,'market_consensus_identified':False,'price_absorption_established':False}

  row.update({'simple_cap_path_change_in_signed_memo':simple,'reported_memo_minus_simple_path':rev[-1]-simple,'cap_arithmetic_matches':rev[-1]==simple,'classification':'POLICY_PREANNOUNCED_CAP_ARITHMETIC_COMPATIBLE_FACT_ONLY' if rev[-1]==simple else 'POLICY_PREANNOUNCED_QUANTITY_DIFFERENCE_UNEXPLAINED'})
 else:

 rows.append(row)
